notes: Australia: the Fair Work Ombudsman handles pay and conditions complaints, mainly by phone, with free interpreters through TIS. The fairwork.gov.au pages timed out when read on 2026-09-28, so these details come from the site's search summaries of the pages listed in sources: read those pages and re-check the numbers before relying on them.

channels.note: Fair Work Infoline, Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm except public holidays
Translating and Interpreting Service (TIS): free interpreter; ask them to call the Fair Work Ombudsman on 13 13 94
Online enquiry, for people who cannot call in business hours; replies can take up to 10 business days
